rationale.complete: Rounds 1 and 2 done. Round 2 ran four pre-registered tests (k-th kick in one read with per-provider and start-bound sensitivity; nudge facilitation vs the nudger's trigger; pooled timer-wake test over regime III; NE43 decomposition), each validated on synthetic outcomes over the real skeleton first, with dated amendments before any outcome. Reserved data and content-defined episodes (R4) not run.
rationale.faithfulness: The refractory-window model stays refuted; the read-out batching rival is now a positive, predicted result in #51 (rho2 0.11, m3 <= m2, robust to Gemini measured starts, the uncertain flag and both start bounds). Facilitation is underpowered; same-trap re-fire loss is not separated from trap selection; pooled results outside #51 are heterogeneous. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F2 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: Concrete operator rules with numbers: merge kicks that would land in one read (the second adds ~10%); a kick read by the next call keeps ~70%; do not re-nudge an agent still in the same unbroken pause chain (0.03 -> 0.05); split swarm-level drops into read cadence and escape per read before blaming a lever (NE43 was longer pauses, not the nudger).

one_line: One read is one kick: in #51 a second directed item read in the same call adds 0.11 of the first, while a kick read by the next call keeps ~0.7; there is no refractory window beyond the read-out.

models.note: no refractory recovery function beyond the read-out; R ~0.7-1.3 for kicks read by a later call
no episode-locked refractory compartment; same-trap nudge loss not separated from trap selection

v2.claim: No refractory window beyond one read-out; only same-call kicks are wasted
v2.rater: 2 raters (coordinator + blind); log-odds mean credence, mean V

raters.claim: Scope: 35 non-holdout periods (mentions identifiable at G51 scale; humans in G04; nudges marginal). Kicks leave no refractory window: a second kick read at a later model call keeps ~80-130% of a first kick's effect at every spacing from 1 min to 4 h; only kicks read in the same call are discounted (R 0.2-0.4).

ladder.factor: calibrated null and identified: synthetic null near 1, planted 30-min habituation recovered; rule reliable 98-100% (one design, credited once)
partial replication: mentions pooled over 15 periods R 0.78; humans G04; nudges G51
intervention partly consistent: mention R invariant across NE43
penalty: estimated call starts misclassify same/next-call pairs; nudge R on a post hoc outcome
